=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text s1 "asdf"
text s2 "Hello, World!"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note reverses bytes, so it is correct for ASCII only; strings up to 256 bytes (longer traps 3)
fn rev a view uchar * to void
r = new uchar 256 0
n = len a
for i ulong n
put r i get a sub sub n 1 i
end
emit part r 0 n
emit nl
end
fn main to int
rev s1
rev s2
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
fdsa
!dlroW ,olleH
</pre>
